```{r helpers}
pick_col <- function(dt, candidates, label = "column", required = TRUE) {
  hits <- candidates[candidates %in% colnames(dt)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    if (required) stop("Could not find ", label, ". Checked: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", "))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  hits[1]
}

clean_gene <- function(x) toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(basename(as.character(x))))
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)      # TP03.117_S25 -> TP03.117 (sequencing sample suffix)
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)          # TP03.117 -> TP03-117
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x); x <- sub("-T$", "", x); x <- sub("T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_N$", "", x); x <- sub("-N$", "", x); x <- sub("NL$", "", x)
  sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)  # TP09-09 -> TP09-9
}

collapse_duplicate_rows_numeric <- function(mat) {
  if (!anyDuplicated(rownames(mat))) return(mat)
  ids <- unique(rownames(mat))
  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ids, function(id) {
    colMeans(mat[rownames(mat) == id, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  rownames(out) <- ids; colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric <- function(mat) {
  if (!anyDuplicated(colnames(mat))) return(mat)
  ids <- unique(colnames(mat))
  out <- do.call(cbind, lapply(ids, function(id) {
    rowMeans(mat[, colnames(mat) == id, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat); colnames(out) <- ids
  out
}

drop_zero_variance_features <- function(mat) {
  keep <- apply(mat, 1, function(z) length(unique(z[is.finite(z)])) > 1)
  mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

make_binary_gene_sample_matrix <- function(events_dt, all_samples, min_mutated_samples = 2) {
  events_dt <- unique(events_dt[, .(feature, sample)])
  recurrent <- events_dt[, .(n = uniqueN(sample)), by = feature][n >= min_mutated_samples, feature]
  if (length(recurrent) == 0) return(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(all_samples)))
  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(recurrent), ncol = length(all_samples),
                dimnames = list(sort(recurrent), sort(all_samples)))
  fill <- events_dt[feature %in% recurrent]
  mat[cbind(fill$feature, fill$sample)] <- 1
  drop_zero_variance_features(mat)
}

KEEP_CLASSES <- c("Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins",
                  "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Nonstop_Mutation",
                  "Splice_Site", "Translation_Start_Site")
```

```{r oncokb}
oncokb_dt <- fread(ONCOKB_GENE_FILE)
gene_col <- pick_col(oncokb_dt, c("Hugo Symbol", "Hugo_Symbol", "Hugo.Symbol", "Gene", "gene"), "OncoKB gene column")
type_col <- pick_col(oncokb_dt, c("Gene Type", "Gene_Type", "Gene.Type", "gene_type"), "OncoKB gene type column")

oncokb_dt[, Gene_clean := clean_gene(get(gene_col))]
oncokb_dt[, Gene_Type_clean := toupper(trimws(as.character(get(type_col))))]
oncokb_driver_genes <- oncokb_dt[grepl("ONCOGENE|TSG", Gene_Type_clean), unique(Gene_clean)]
length(oncokb_driver_genes)
```

```{r rna-view}
# RNA view: already VST-normalized, top 5000 variable genes
rna_obj <- readRDS(RNA_VST_FILE)

if (is.data.frame(rna_obj)) {
  rna_dt <- as.data.table(rna_obj)
  gcol <- pick_col(rna_dt, c("Gene", "gene", "gene_name", "Hugo_Symbol", "hgnc_symbol", "symbol", "ensembl_gene_id"),
                   "RNA feature column", required = FALSE)
  if (!is.na(gcol)) {
    feats <- rna_dt[[gcol]]
    rna_dt[, (gcol) := NULL]
    rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_dt)
    rownames(rna_mat) <- feats
  } else {
    rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_obj)
  }
} else {
  rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_obj)
}

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(rna_mat)), !is.null(colnames(rna_mat)))
storage.mode(rna_mat) <- "numeric"

rna_raw_samples <- colnames(rna_mat)
rownames(rna_mat) <- trimws(as.character(rownames(rna_mat)))
colnames(rna_mat) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(rna_mat))

# Check: gene ID type (GSEA later needs gene symbols)
message("Fraction of Ensembl-style row names: ",
        round(mean(grepl("^ENSG", rownames(rna_mat))), 3))
message("First features: ", paste(head(rownames(rna_mat), 5), collapse = ", "))

rna_mat <- collapse_duplicate_rows_numeric(rna_mat)
rna_mat <- collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric(rna_mat)
rna_mat <- rna_mat[apply(rna_mat, 1, function(z) any(is.finite(z))), , drop = FALSE]

# Only re-select if the file has more than 5000 genes
if (nrow(rna_mat) > TOP_N_RNA_GENES) {
  rna_var <- apply(rna_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  rna_mat <- rna_mat[names(sort(rna_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(TOP_N_RNA_GENES)], , drop = FALSE]
}
rna_mat <- drop_zero_variance_features(rna_mat)

dim(rna_mat)

# Raw -> cleaned sample ID mapping, to inspect ID problems
fwrite(data.table(raw_id = rna_raw_samples, clean_id = clean_sample_id(rna_raw_samples)),
       file.path(TABLE_DIR, "RNA_sample_ID_mapping_GENCODEv47.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

```{r wes-mutation-view}
wes_maf <- fread(WES_MAF_FILE)
miss <- setdiff(c("Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification"), colnames(wes_maf))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns in WES MAF: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

wes_maf[, `:=`(sample = clean_sample_id(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
               feature = clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol),
               variant_class = trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification)))]

if ("FILTER" %in% colnames(wes_maf)) {
  wes_maf <- wes_maf[is.na(FILTER) | FILTER == "" | toupper(trimws(as.character(FILTER))) == "PASS"]
}
wes_maf <- wes_maf[variant_class %in% KEEP_CLASSES]

wes_all_samples <- sort(unique(wes_maf$sample))
wes_mut_events  <- wes_maf[feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes, .(feature, sample)]

wes_mut_mat <- make_binary_gene_sample_matrix(wes_mut_events, wes_all_samples, MIN_MUTATED_SAMPLES)
dim(wes_mut_mat)
```

```{r wes-cnv-view}
wes_cnv <- fread(WES_CNV_FILE)
miss <- setdiff(c("Sample", "SYMBOL", "VARIANT_CLASS"), colnames(wes_cnv))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns in WES CNV: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

wes_cnv[, `:=`(sample = clean_sample_id(Sample),
               feature = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
               cnv_call = toupper(trimws(as.character(VARIANT_CLASS))))]

# Homdel = -2, Hetdel = -1, Neutral = 0, Gain = 1, Amp = 2
wes_cnv[, cnv_value := fifelse(
  grepl("HOMDEL|HOMODEL|HOMOZYGOUS.*DEL|DEEP.*DEL", cnv_call), -2,
  fifelse(grepl("HETDEL|HETEROZYGOUS.*DEL|SHALLOW.*DEL|LOSS|DEL", cnv_call), -1,
  fifelse(grepl("AMP|AMPLIFICATION", cnv_call), 2,
  fifelse(grepl("GAIN|DUP", cnv_call), 1,
  fifelse(grepl("NEUTRAL|DIPLOID|NONE|NO[_ ]?CALL|WT", cnv_call), 0, NA_real_)))))]

wes_cnv_long <- wes_cnv[feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes & is.finite(cnv_value),
                        .(feature, sample, value = cnv_value)]

# If a gene-sample pair is duplicated, keep the strongest call
wes_cnv_long <- wes_cnv_long[, .(value = value[which.max(abs(value))[1]]), by = .(feature, sample)]

wes_cnv_wide <- dcast(wes_cnv_long, feature ~ sample, value.var = "value", fill = 0)
wes_cnv_mat <- as.matrix(wes_cnv_wide[, -"feature"])
rownames(wes_cnv_mat) <- wes_cnv_wide$feature
storage.mode(wes_cnv_mat) <- "numeric"
wes_cnv_mat <- drop_zero_variance_features(wes_cnv_mat)
dim(wes_cnv_mat)
```

```{r impact-view}
impact_raw <- fread(IMPACT_FILE)
miss <- setdiff(c("TUMOR_SAMPLE", "SYMBOL", "Variant_Classification"), colnames(impact_raw))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns in IMPACT: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

impact_raw[, `:=`(sample = clean_sample_id(TUMOR_SAMPLE),
                  feature = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
                  variant_class = trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification)))]

impact_all_samples <- sort(unique(impact_raw$sample))   # keep samples even without retained mutations

impact_events <- unique(impact_raw[variant_class %in% KEEP_CLASSES & feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes,
                                   .(feature, sample)])

impact_genes <- sort(unique(impact_events$feature))
impact_mut_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(impact_genes), ncol = length(impact_all_samples),
                         dimnames = list(impact_genes, impact_all_samples))
if (nrow(impact_events) > 0) impact_mut_mat[cbind(impact_events$feature, impact_events$sample)] <- 1
impact_mut_mat <- impact_mut_mat[rowSums(impact_mut_mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]  # no recurrence filter (targeted panel)
dim(impact_mut_mat)
```

```{r save-views-and-check-overlap}
view_mats <- list(
  RNA_VST_top5000var     = rna_mat,
  WES_CNV_numeric        = wes_cnv_mat,
  WES_mutation_recurrent = wes_mut_mat,
  IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB = impact_mut_mat
)
view_mats <- view_mats[vapply(view_mats, function(x) is.matrix(x) && nrow(x) > 0 && ncol(x) > 0, logical(1))]
saveRDS(view_mats, VIEW_MATRIX_RDS)

view_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  m <- view_mats[[v]]
  data.table(view = v, n_features = nrow(m), n_samples = ncol(m),
             n_missing_values = sum(!is.finite(m)))
}))
print(view_summary)
fwrite(view_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_prepared_view_summary_GENCODEv47.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ---- Sample ID overlap check (RNA vs the other views) ----
other_samples <- unique(unlist(lapply(view_mats[names(view_mats) != "RNA_VST_top5000var"], colnames)))
rna_samples   <- colnames(view_mats$RNA_VST_top5000var)
message("RNA samples: ", length(rna_samples),
        " | found in at least one other view: ", length(intersect(rna_samples, other_samples)))
message("RNA-only samples (check IDs): ", paste(setdiff(rna_samples, other_samples), collapse = ", "))

# Presence of each sample across views
sample_view_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  data.table(sample = colnames(view_mats[[v]]), view = v, present = 1)
}))
sample_summary <- dcast(sample_view_dt, sample ~ view, value.var = "present", fill = 0)
view_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_summary), "sample")
sample_summary[, n_views_present := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = view_cols]
sample_summary <- sample_summary[order(-n_views_present, sample)]
print(sample_summary)
fwrite(sample_summary, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_prepared_sample_view_presence_GENCODEv47.tsv"), sep = "\t")

if (sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N] == 0) stop("No samples shared across >= 2 views. Check sample IDs.")

lapply(view_mats, dim)
```
